name: geoid-datum-to-geojson-no-position
source: synthetic: the input of 03-degrees-object-id-to-geojson with Location.datum (7.6.8) set to 2, by a small field editor (varint replaced, lengths rewritten)
reference: location.proto: datum 2 is the WGS84 geoid; lat, lon and hae are read only for coordinate system 1 with datum 1 (WGS84 ellipsoid), so the message decodes as detection_report_other_system and reaches GeoJSON without a position
